name: SLR-Bench-French
description:
🧠 SLR-Bench-French: Scalable Logical Reasoning Benchmark (French Edition)
	





	
		
	
	
		SLR-Bench Versions:
	







SLR-Bench-French is the French-language pendant of the original SLR-Bench dataset.
It follows the same symbolic structure, evaluation framework, and curriculum as the English version but provides all natural-language task prompts translated into French.
This enables systematic evaluation and training of Large Language Models (LLMs) in logical reasoning in French… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ahmad21omar/SLR-Bench-French.
reputation: A French-language replica of the SLR-Bench used by researchers evaluating multilingual logical reasoning in LLMs; modest adoption within the evaluation community.
